Implement TTLCache(capacity, clock), where capacity is a positive integer or construction raises ValueError, and clock is an injected callable returning monotonic seconds. put(key, value, ttl) sets an entry to expire at clock()+ttl. ttl <= 0 deletes that key and stores nothing. get(key, default=None) returns default for missing or expired keys. Expiration is inclusive: now >= expiry is expired. Successful get and positive-ttl put make the key most recently used. Updating an existing key resets its expiry and must not evict another key. Before evicting for capacity, remove ALL expired entries. Evict the least recently used live entry if necessary. Values including None and False must work. Do not sleep or use the real clock.
